thread:
priya: Heads-up — planning a small routing nudge from eu-west -> na-central for the model-serving pool. Target: start 10:00 UTC, initial 15% for 10m, then 50% if green. Looking for a deployer and someone to own metrics + smoke checks. Rollback plan ready. Who's available?

alex: I can be primary deployer. I'll be at my laptop at 09:55 UTC. Will run the policy apply and watch controller logs.

jorge: I can own metrics/dashboards (inference-service overview, route:eu-west, errors/latency). Share exact dashboards you want me to watch.

emma: I'll handle smoke checks and run the small load script. I can run quick curl checks + a tiny hey load for latency.

priya: Thanks — plan outline:
1) at 10:00 apply the routing policy (15%).
2) wait 5-10m for steady state, run smoke loops (emma).
3) if everything looks good, increase to 50% at ~10:25.
Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx > 2x baseline for 3m OR p95 > 1s. TTLs are 60s so traffic swap should be reversible.

alex: copy. Will run through steps and post outputs.

priya: policy diff (small snippet):
```yaml
- routing:
-   eu-west: 85
-   na-central: 15
+ routing:
+   eu-west: 85
+   na-central: 15
```
(applied via infra repo -> terraform module.route_config)

emma: smoke check cmds I'll run:
```bash
# health
curl -sS -I "https://inference.eu-west.redwood/api/v1/health" | head -n 1
# tiny load sample
hey -n 200 -c 10 "https://inference.eu-west.redwood/api/v1/predict" -m POST -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
I'll post a short summary after the first 10m.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: starting apply by alex at 1993301720 (plan -> apply).

alex: terraform apply complete, controllers acked, logs: `route-controller: applied policy v3` :white_check_mark:

emma: initial smoke (10:07): health 200, median 95ms, p95 180ms, no 5xx. hey run shows no errors.

jorge: metrics quick check (10:12): p50 ~100ms, p95 ~195ms (baseline p95 ~160ms), error rate flat. Traces show a handful of KV-cache cold misses on two nodes. Nothing alarming.

priya: good — proceed to increase to 50% at ~10:25 if no objections. alex, want to bump?

alex: increasing to 50% now (running terraform apply -> set na-central:50).

sre-bot: routing update: na-central set to 50% at 1993303220.

emma: post-increase smoke (10:28): p95 rose to ~240ms, p50 ~120ms, still within SLO. No new 5xx. Running extended smoke for 30m.

jorge: watching traces and infra metrics — no GC spikes, CPU up 5-7% on a few pods but within reserves. I'll alert if error rate or latency crosses thresholds.

priya: quick reminder of rollback exact command if needed:
```bash
# rollback to previous split (15%)
cd infra/route-config && terraform apply -var='na_central_percent=15' -auto-approve
# verify controllers
kubectl -n infra logs deployment/route-controller | tail -n 50
```
If triggered, alex please run rollback and post confirmation.

alex: ack. If I see sustained 5xx or p95 > 1s for 3m I'll rollback immediately.

emma: continuing smoke loop. Will post summary every 10m.

jorge: agreed on rollback triggers. I'll escalate to on-call if we need infra help.

priya: thanks all. Everyone okay with proceeding and standing by?

alex: :thumbsup:

jorge: ack

emma: ack, standing by

priya: closing the loop here — I'll add a short note to the runbook with timestamps and the policy revision id. If anything changes post-10:55 UTC I'll update this thread.

sre-bot: note: route-config version v3 applied by alex at 1993301720, updated to v4 (50%) at 1993303220.
